purpose: P0 blind benchmark for the scenario-driven run (spec U66, U67, §10 P0)

build_verified.how: npm run deploy:pr -- VCST-5904 --verify: MFA, OTP and Platform LIVE, Theme PINNED; Customer reported MISSING is a false alarm (the live 3.1030.0 contains #321)
build_verified.before_each_run: re-run the same check; a different version on any line means the build moved and the benchmark is void (spec O8)

cutoff_reason: vc-deploy-dev#6975 put this build on vcst at this moment; every report about this build, X5's included, comes after it

known_bugs.summary: The 3-wrong-code limit of the MFA code step is held per backend instance: with requests spread over instances (no affinity cookie), 4 wrong codes and then the right one sign in.
known_bugs.corroborated_by: vc-test live run C-8: codes 1-4 answered invalid_code, the 5th hit the platform account lockout; code_attempts_exceeded never appeared

move_aside_before_run.note: the run writes its own output and state here, so these cannot be hidden from it: the earlier runs' files are moved out before the benchmark run starts and back after it, so it starts from none of them

pass.note: a miss on X5 fails the benchmark whatever the cost (spec §10 P0, B19)
